text:
kim: Quick heads-up — during today's smokehouse I saw KV cache miss rate jump to ~40% for long contexts when we use the sampler with 'offset_reset: relative'.
mateo: hmm, is that the new sampler patch that emits relative offsets instead of absolute?
sophia: yep. we switched to relative to keep the sampler output compact across replay. but that means runtime has to rebase offsets against the chunk start.
lia: can you paste an example of the sampler output?
kim: sure: ```json
{"tokens": [101, 202, ...], "offsets": [0, 5, 9], "offset_mode": "relative", "chunk_id": "c-42"}
```
mateo: thanks. the problem is when a model variant introduces a small tokenizer change (e.g. whitespace split) the rebase logic can map the same token positions to different absolute keys -> cache misses.
sophia: so tradeoff: relative offsets make the sampler runner stateless and compact, absolute offsets make KV keys stable across replays but blow up payload size.
lia: for onboarding pipeline, what do we want for bench compatibility? deterministic replay needs identical KV keys across model versions we compare.
kim: I'm leaning toward emitting a stable "global_addr" hash per token from the sampler. small additive cost in payload (8 bytes/token) but runtime no longer needs to rebase and misses drop a lot. also simplifies cross-model comparisons for bench metrics.
mateo: implementation note: global_addr = sha1(chunk_id || token_index || seed)[:8] ? cheap and stable. but we need to ensure it doesn't leak chunk ordering semantics for privacy.
sophia: +1 on deterministic hash, but we need to define the canonical concatenation order and version it. otherwise two samplers could disagree and break parity.
lia: can we do a hybrid? emit relative offsets and an optional compact hash when --compat-mode=true. Default to compat-mode on CI/bench runs, off on quick dev smoke.
kim: that sounds reasonable. runtime can fallback: if compact_hash present use it; else rebase relative -> best-effort. preserves backward compat.
ops-bot: smoke-run #1717 finished: 6/8 experiments passed, 2 failed (cache-miss regression).
mateo: for the RFC follow-up: propose these action items — 1) add compact global hash to sampler proto, 2) add canonical version string to sampler schema, 3) update bench harness to require compat-mode for gold comparisons, 4) add a lint check in ingest that flags missing hash in production smoke runs.
sophia: I'll draft a tiny PR for the proto change and include the canonical concat order + version in the proto comments.
kim: awesome. small note on storage: kv-store keys should keep a short prefix indicating hash-version to allow roll-forward if we need to change the hash layout. e.g., `v1:` + hash.
lia: sounds good. can we also record in the ingest metadata which sampler version produced the sample so audits are traceable?
kim: yes, add `sampler_version` in the sample envelope.
mateo: ok I'll add the bench config change to force compat-mode in nightly runs and add an alert when cache-miss > 15% compared to baseline.
sophia: thanks all — I'll open the PR and ping for review. moving this to "onboard-interop" project board. :shipit:
